It is to be noted that the GST will be NIL aga inst notification No: 28/2018- Central Tax (Rate) Dtd. 31.12.2018. 2. Validity of the Contract: 02 years from the date of release of PO and shall be extendable on same terms for further period of 1 year on mutual agreement basis. 3.The consignment shall be lifted from DFPCL, Taloja, Mumbai (as per supply orders placed on the above Manufacturer). 4. Penalty for Late Delivery: Materials collected by the transporter should be delivered at Rasayani within 2 4 hours per 400 Km distance. If delivery is not done within this period, the transporter shall be liable to pa y minimum penalty charge at the rate of 0.5% of the cost of goods for each day of delay. 5. Payment will be made after receipt of the item per tonnage basis supply at Purchaser’s site within 30 da ys by online transfer. 6. Contractor shall submit a valid INDEMNITY BOND after release of PO worth Rs. 15 Lakhs, on non-judicial bond paper, indemnify PCR/SDSC SHAR (ISRO) towards any loss of consignment during transportation. The INDEMNITY BOND shall be valid up to the contract period plus sixty days. This Indemnity Bond is in additio n to the SD BG as per prevailing norm (at present 3% of order value). OR After placement of order, Contractor can take an All risk insurance cover for Rs. 15 Lakh (Fifteen Lakh rupe es), with SDSC SHAR, ISRO as beneficiary, towards cost of material being transported from supplier’s site t o our site. The insurance policy should cover all risks which cause loss of material during transportation inc luding fire, theft, burglary, riot, civil commotion, terrorist act etc. Contractor shall bear all cost related to In surance policy i.e. policy issuance cost, claim settlement cost or any cost related to policy. This Insurance cover is in addition to the SD BG as asked in Bid. 7. Quantity variation of +/- 10% is applicable on the ordered quantity 8.
